name: 黑羽夫人
evolution: 乖乖鹄 → 蓝珠天鹅 Lv.20 → 黑羽夫人 Lv.40
description: 天鹅精灵中罕见的独居分支，对社交并不热衷。羽毛长而卷翘，摸起来有些刺手，似乎并不符合种族中普遍的审美，但自信令她看起来非常优雅。
descriptionEn: A rare solitary branch among swan creatures, not keen on socializing. Its feathers are long and curled, feeling a bit prickly to the touch, seemingly not fitting the common aesthetic of the species, but its confidence makes it look very elegant.

skills.name: 鸣叫
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 潮涌
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 风矢
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 风隐
skills.description: 敌方和自己均脱离，先手-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Both enemy and self escape; first-strike -1.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; Swift; on counter: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.

skills.name: 迫害
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 撕咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，3连击，若自己的生命低于50%，本次技能连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 3-hit combo; if own HP below 50%, combo count +2.

skills.name: 等价交换
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：自己获得50%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 90%; on counter: gain 50% lifesteal.

skills.name: 栽赃
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 灾厄
skills.description: 对自己造成物伤，应对状态：改为对敌方造成物伤，且本次技能威力+120。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to self; on counter: instead deal to enemy, and this skill's power +120.

skills.name: 羽翼庇护
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：自己获得连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 70%; on counter: gain combo count +2.
